svg.title: The two brand icon candidates
svg.desc: Candidate A, the bear head under the cowboy hat with the star, and candidate B, the marshal star badge, each in colour at 64, 28 and 16 pixels (the favicon, with the attention dot) and in monochrome at 64, 24 and 16 pixels, on the light theme above and the dark theme below. Candidate A's favicon shows only the hat with the star.
